cited_title: MoCha-Stereo: Motif Channel Attention Network for Stereo Matching
primary_explanation: MoCha-Stereo describes a motif channel attention stereo matching network (an attention-based architecture) rather than a GRU-based iterative disparity-update method. Citing it as a GRU-iteration method is therefore incorrect.
